brief_title: Weekly GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Obese Individuals Without Diabetes
official_title: Evaluating the Efficacy of Various Weekly GLP1receptor Agonist Among Obese Individuals Without Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: change in body weight at 3 and 6 months
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Baseline, Week 12 (3 months) and Week 24 (6 months)

brief_summary: This randomized controlled trial evaluates the efficacy of three weekly GLP-1 receptor agonists (dulaglutide, semaglutide, and tirzepatide) in non-diabetic obese adults. 150 participants with BMI \>30 will be randomized into three groups and followed for 6 months to assess changes in weight, BMI, lipid profile, and liver functions.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects (above 18 years old) obese body mass index (BMI) above 30

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects with liver disease, renal dysfunction diabetes, pancreatic diseases ,thyroid disorder or goiter psychological diseases like depression and pregnant women, and Patients who will refuse
